description: This file defines the DroppingStream class, which implements a stream decorator that drops data when the underlying stream exceeds a maximum size. It is part of the GuzzleHttp Psr7 namespace, serving as a tool for managing stream data in HTTP message handling.

classes.name: DroppingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that drops data once a maximum size threshold is exceeded. Implements the StreamInterface and uses the StreamDecoratorTrait for common stream behaviors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a DroppingStream by wrapping an underlying stream and setting a maximum length threshold.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the underlying stream, dropping any data that would exceed the maximum length.
